results.title: Ashamed
results.overview: Before his childhood best friend leaves for good, a closeted married man has one last chance to show the truth — or stay trapped in a life that was never really his.

results.title: Paris Paris
results.overview: Three men—from China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Palestine—live together in a squatted apartment in a seemingly abandoned building in Paris. The group is bound together by their shared experience of life in exile and the fleeting nature of their possessions, relationships, and sense of home, but the temporary safe space is threatened by outside forces and events.

results.title: Breaking Walls
results.overview: Journalist and activist Hoi Yi fights against the global rise of surveillance and censorship, while suppressing his queer identity from his family. The personal repression he faces is reflected in his commitment to the freedom of others.

results.title: Wait
results.overview: ‘Wait’ explores the anxiety of waiting for something positive or negative, showing how these two identities can appear almost identical. Similar actions can have different meanings. Two stories, one screen. What you think will happen may not always be the case.

results.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
results.overview: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

results.title: Tired of Being a Nerd
results.overview: A loser goes to his college reunion determined to unmask a vegan alien cult's ritual murder, clear his name and recover the heart of his soul mate.  Oh yeah, he also wants to get out alive.

results.title: Blood and Marble
results.overview: A portuguese noir. The mysterious murder of Sequeira, a powerful businessman in the stone finishing (marble) industry from Vilar do Paraíso, whose lifeless body was found near the Santo Inácio Zoo in Avintes.

results.title: The Deb
results.overview: An original musical comedy about two teenage cousins who dig deep to find self acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia. Rebel Wilson's hotly anticipated directorial debut.

results.title: Zejtune
results.overview: Mar is ready to leave the tiny island of Malta behind, and her estranged mother's death gives her the perfect way out: an inheritance of valuable farmland that she can sell. But when greedy relatives contest her claim, Mar's plans hit a snag. As she fights to secure her future, Mar meets Nenu, a spirited troubadour whose vibrant folk songs, rooted in Malta's ancient għana tradition, awaken emotions she's long buried.

results.title: Génération plastique
results.overview: 1962. Françoise, a housewife, tries to overcome her shyness by inviting her neighbours round for the first time in order to show them a mysterious object. Six very different women will be brought together, unaware that this seemingly trivial gathering will change their lives.

results.title: Memory
results.overview: After her parents’ divorce, six-year-old Vladlena moves from Crimea to Grozny, not yet aware of the changes that lie ahead. When war breaks out in Chechnya, it deeply affects her city and family. Years later, filmmaker Sandu reflects on her childhood in this poetic, autobiographical hybrid film, exploring how cycles of violence shape children—and how healing and change are possible.

results.title: Foxhole
results.overview: After witnessing the death of several of their friends in a bloody skirmish, three battle-worn British soldiers must decide the fate of a lone fifteen-year-old German soldier.

results.title: Instinto
results.overview: This is the story of a group of women who come together to create a play about maternal instinct, abortion, and social norms.

results.title: Der Garmisch Krimi - Wolfsmord
results.overview: A murder case in Garmisch: the victim is the chairman of the nature conservation association, at a time when wolves are on the loose and the population is divided into wolf opponents and supporters. Investigators Ira Zach and Daphne Meindl pick up the trail.

results.title: Crudo
results.overview: A year after her dismissal from a Michelin-starred restaurant, Chef Grace Collins, now managing a more modest eatery, has an unsavory encounter with the critic responsible for her firing.

results.title: Nostalgia for the Future
results.overview: The evocative narration of Charlotte Rampling guides a descent into the labyrinthine world of Chris Marker, the best-known author of unknown films, who spent a lifetime concealing himself behind a veil of pseudonyms and images of cats. Moving through a constellation of personal documents and film fragments, an archivist attempts to decode the man through the material traces he left behind.

results.title: Dear Sobriety: You're Killing Me
results.overview: Raffi, nearly forty and defiant of the system, has cycled through rehab countless times. After being kicked out of the clinic in his fifth attempt to get clean, he is forced to return to the person he despises most: his mother. Two days later, she kicks him out, and Raffi turns to Trino, his last remaining friend, for refuge. When he learns that his high school crush, Inés, is newly divorced, Raffi vows to win her over, even if it means getting a regular job, growing up, and finally taking his recovery seriously.

results.title: 9 Temples to Heaven
results.original_title: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
results.overview: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.

results.title: The Ghost Killer
results.overview: Old Wu, once a top assassin, lived a peaceful life under an assumed name at the Renxintang Pharmacy. However, this tranquility was shattered when single mother Song Xiaoqian was kidnapped by a gang. To rescue Xiaoqian, Old Wu returned to the underworld, engaging in a life-or-death struggle against a criminal gang led by Third Master and Zuo Lun. In the process, Old Wu uncovered the truth behind the murder of his wife and daughter ten years prior, discovering that the mastermind behind it all was none other than Master Xiang, whom he once respected. Ultimately, with his superb martial arts skills and unwavering conviction, Old Wu avenged his family and the innocent by killing his enemies and delivering justice.
